AI reading sends this PDF or photo through the app’s server to Anthropic (the maker of Claude) to be read — unlike the local upload/paste options above, which never leave your device. The app doesn’t keep the file: only a count of your AI requests and what they cost. Anthropic handles it under its own commercial terms. A cutsheet can include a client’s project name, location, and coordinates. If any of that is confidential or sensitive, use local upload/paste instead, or redact first. AI reading is part of the paid plans and the beta, with limits per person: company plan 100 requests a day; individual plan 15 stake reads and 5 questions a day, 200 a month; beta 30 a day.
